svg.title: Figure 3-2. Hardware element hierarchy of the comma device and harness (WP-H-02 §2, §3.2, §5)
svg.desc: The LD-SDA system of WP-C-01 Figure 3-1 consists of five components; the two hardware components, E-04 device hardware and E-05 harness, are decomposed here into the hardware elements of WP-H-02 §3.2. E-04 exists in two variants (§2): comma 3X with the tres panda board and comma four with the cuatro board; the mapping is inferred (OI-3). E-04 consists of 22 parts: seven resources of the panda safety MCU STM32H725 (HE-01 core, HE-02 flash, HE-03 SRAM, HE-04 clock, HE-05 MCU power, HE-06 IWDG1, HE-15 die temperature sensor), four board circuits (HE-07 CAN transceivers, HE-14 input voltage and current sensing, HE-16 fan, HE-17 siren), three SoC-MCU lines (HE-11 SPI link, HE-12 reset and boot-mode lines, HE-13 bootkick) and eight QM parts (application SoC, cameras, IR illumination, display, modem, GNSS, IMU, USB). E-05 consists of HE-08 intercept relay (driven by the panda MCU), HE-09 harness connector and SBU lines and HE-10 ignition sense. Each element shows its safety goals, the hardware safety requirements WP-H-02 names for it, and its unknowns UK-01 to UK-08 that are still to be obtained. HE-06 is implemented but not verified on hardware. The harness adapter with DC-02 and DC-03 is proposed and not decided (OI-4).
